en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing central Ljubljana with a view over the Ljubljanica River toward the main square, labeled Marijin trg/Marienplatz. A stone bridge spans the river (the earlier Franz's Bridge, later part of the Triple Bridge). The Franciscan Church is visible on the left and historic buildings line the square. The reverse has a handwritten message, a postage stamp and cancellations.
